title: How to Write Better Documentation
summary: Practical techniques for skimmable, unambiguous documentation accessible to readers with varying technical backgrounds.
when-to-read: Read when writing or revising any technical documentation and want general clarity/skimmability guidance that applies across document types. Do not read to decide which type of document to write in the first place (see start-here-diataxis) — this is about prose quality, not document-type selection.
